name: qa-pilot
description: QA copilot for existing projects: audit your test codebase, cover new code with tests in one command (gap check → scenarios → Playwright tests → review), audit requirements & test plans against a 1100+ rule QA catalog, and add a cheap per-task QA step (AC check, impact map, guarded tests) and a whole-project QA audit, and run exploratory browser testing — with strict quality gates and token economy for subscription plans.
